p: rest for the ark of the: Where the ark would stay and no longer move to and fro.
Judah: According to the prophecy of Jacob, Ge 49:8.
this day: If he continues to keep my law as he does now and doesn't depart from it.
good land: That is, of Canaan.
for ever: He declares that nothing can separate them from the conveniences of this land, both for themselves and their posterity except for their sins and iniquity.
an house for the sanctuary: Meaning, for his ark.
do it: Put it in execution.
candlesticks of gold: That is, the ten candlesticks, 1Ki 7:49.
the chariot of the cherubims: Meaning, of the mercy seat that covered the ark, which was called the chariot, because the Lord declared himself there.
by his hand upon me: For all this was left in writing in the book of the Law, Ex 25:40, which the king was bound to put in execution, De 17:19.
every willing skilful man: That is, everyone will be ready to help you with those gifts that God has given him.
